title: Recording: It’s No Secret by Ringo Starr | 1977
content:
Atlantic Studios, New York City
Producer: Arif Mardin
Engineer: Lew Hahn

Ringo Starr began recording ‘It’s No Secret’ for his sixth studio album, Ringo The 4th, on 25 January 1977.

It was written by Starr and Vini Poncia, one of six such collaborations on the album. ‘Tango All Night’ was issued as a single in 1978 in Argentina, with ‘It’s No Secret’ on the b-side.
